verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes its own Data Access API, an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document on SwaggerHub with reference pages for pagination, rate limiting, authentication and versioning. It is described as giving access to "errors, projects, organization and more," but nothing shows it matches everything the dashboard can do (e.g., triage actions, assignment rules, stability targets, discard rules). The docs-path OpenAPI probes returned 404, but the spec exists on SwaggerHub, so this does not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, evidence that dashboard configuration and triage actions are exposed via the API, independent hands-on corroboration of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Allows you to access information about your BugSnag errors, projects, organization and more to build custom integrations using your data.
SwaggerHub-published OpenAPI 3.0.3 document: info.title "BugSnag - Data Access API"
